name: Akihabara only, cards and retro games
tag: On foot, no trains, finish by 16:30
why: Everything stays inside one square mile. The graded-card lounge opens at 11:00, so the day starts there and the rest follows on foot.
steps: Meet at the Electric Town Exit.

steps.maps: Akihabara Station Electric Town Exit, Tokyo

steps: Trading cards on floors 1 to 3. PSA Lounge Tokyo is on the 5th floor, open 11:00 to 14:00 and 15:00 to 19:30, and closed on Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

steps.maps: SNKRDUNK Trading Card Akihabara, 1-14-1 Sotokanda, Chiyoda, Tokyo
Akihabara Station, Tokyo

steps: Eight floors of vintage toys, manga and collectibles. Open 12:00 to 20:00 every day.

steps.maps: Mandarake Complex, 3-11-12 Sotokanda, Chiyoda, Tokyo

steps: Retro games on floors 3 to 5, with a retro arcade on the 5th floor. Open 11:00 to 20:00 every day.

steps.maps: Super Potato Akihabara, 1-11-2 Sotokanda, Chiyoda, Tokyo

steps: A large arcade near the station, open every day. Finish here, or keep browsing.

steps.maps: Hey Akihabara, 1-10-5 Sotokanda, Chiyoda, Tokyo

stops: Akihabara Station Electric Town Exit, Tokyo
SNKRDUNK Trading Card Akihabara, 1-14-1 Sotokanda, Chiyoda, Tokyo
Super Potato Akihabara, 1-11-2 Sotokanda, Chiyoda, Tokyo
moves: Everything is a few minutes on foot.
good: Collectors who want the most time in front of the cases.
mind: The PSA Lounge is closed from 14:00 to 15:00 and on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. The first stop opens at 11:00.

name: Akihabara, then Shibuya for Nintendo
tag: Half a day on foot, then one train ride
why: A shorter card round in the morning, then Nintendo TOKYO and the Pokémon Center on the same floor of Shibuya PARCO.
steps: Meet at the Electric Town Exit.

steps.maps: Akihabara Station Electric Town Exit, Tokyo

steps: Trading cards on floors 1 to 3, and PSA Lounge Tokyo on the 5th floor. The lounge is open 11:00 to 14:00, so we go first.

steps.maps: SNKRDUNK Trading Card Akihabara, 1-14-1 Sotokanda, Chiyoda, Tokyo

steps: Retro games on floors 3 to 5 and a retro arcade on the 5th. Open 11:00 to 20:00.

steps.maps: Super Potato Akihabara, 1-11-2 Sotokanda, Chiyoda, Tokyo
Akihabara Station, Tokyo

steps: One train ride on the Yamanote Line.

steps.maps: Shibuya Station, Tokyo

steps: Shibuya PARCO, 6th floor. Open 10:00 to 21:00. On busy days entry is by free numbered ticket.

steps.maps: Nintendo TOKYO, Shibuya PARCO 6F, 15-1 Udagawacho, Shibuya, Tokyo

steps: On the same floor of Shibuya PARCO. Open 10:00 to 21:00. The day ends here.

steps.maps: Pokémon Center Shibuya, Shibuya PARCO 6F, 15-1 Udagawacho, Shibuya, Tokyo

stops: Akihabara Station Electric Town Exit, Tokyo
SNKRDUNK Trading Card Akihabara, 1-14-1 Sotokanda, Chiyoda, Tokyo
Super Potato Akihabara, 1-11-2 Sotokanda, Chiyoda, Tokyo
Nintendo TOKYO, Shibuya PARCO 6F, 15-1 Udagawacho, Shibuya, Tokyo
Pokémon Center Shibuya, Shibuya PARCO 6F, 15-1 Udagawacho, Shibuya, Tokyo
moves: Short walks in Akihabara, then one train ride.
good: A mix of card hunting and the big Nintendo and Pokémon stores.
mind: Shibuya PARCO is crowded in the afternoon. The 6th floor is reached by the marked stairs, and the elevators do not stop there before 10:00.

name: Pokémon Centers across the city
tag: Three areas, trains between, a full day
why: Two of the largest Pokémon Centers, with the Pokémon Cafe nearby, and a card stop in Akihabara to close the day.
steps: Meet at the Electric Town Exit.

steps.maps: Akihabara Station Electric Town Exit, Tokyo
Ikebukuro Station, Tokyo

steps: Sunshine City alpa, 2nd floor. Open 10:00 to 20:00. The shop reopened on 24 August 2026 after a closure and entry may be limited, so we check its notices first.

steps.maps: Pokémon Center MEGA TOKYO, Sunshine City alpa 2F, 3-1-2 Higashiikebukuro, Toshima, Tokyo
Sunshine City, Ikebukuro, Tokyo
Nihonbashi Station, Tokyo

steps: Nihonbashi Takashimaya S.C. East Building, 5th floor. Open 10:30 to 21:00.

steps.maps: Pokémon Center TOKYO DX, Nihonbashi Takashimaya S.C. East Building 5F, 2-11-2 Nihonbashi, Chuo, Tokyo

steps: Nearby in the same complex. Seats are booked on the official site only, so book before the day if you want a table.

steps.maps: Pokémon Cafe TOKYO, Nihonbashi Takashimaya S.C. East Building, 2-11-2 Nihonbashi, Chuo, Tokyo

steps: One last card stop. SNKRDUNK is open until 21:00, and PSA Lounge Tokyo is open until 19:30 with last intake at 18:30.

steps.maps: SNKRDUNK Trading Card Akihabara, 1-14-1 Sotokanda, Chiyoda, Tokyo

stops: Akihabara Station Electric Town Exit, Tokyo

moves: Three train rides between the areas.
good: Anyone who wants the big stores and the merchandise.
mind: The most train time of the three plans. The cafe needs a booking. Check the MEGA TOKYO notices for entry rules before the day.
